name: 01 / GHOST ACCOUNT
story: A fixer called Wisp pays you to erase a debt. The account belongs to someone declared dead yesterday. Their balance is still buying neural implants.
reveal: The account was a test subject. Every payment points to HELIX, the city's largest megacorp.

name: 02 / DEAD LETTER
story: Intercept a courier node before its memory is wiped. Wisp recognizes the subject's name. It was her brother.
reveal: The courier holds a list of thousands. HELIX is copying people into a private Matrix.

name: 03 / BLACK CLINIC
story: Break into the clinic network. Find out what happens to the bodies after the copies are made.
reveal: The copies power an autonomous control system called CROWN. The originals never leave the clinic.

name: 04 / FALSE SKY
story: Wisp has a broadcast slot. Steal a signing key so the city can see the evidence. HELIX knows your handle now.
reveal: The evidence is live. CROWN starts its lockdown early. You have one route left: straight into HELIX.

name: 05 / ROOT ACCESS
story: Fight through the corporate backbone. Wisp can keep a route open, but only if you kill the root guardian.
reveal: Root access granted. CROWN offers you a place inside its perfect city. You decline.

name: 06 / NO GODS IN THE WIRE
story: The city is watching. Free the trapped minds and sever CROWN before its lockdown becomes permanent.
reveal: CROWN falls. The captive minds spill into the open Matrix. HELIX loses its grip on the city. Wisp sends one final message: We owe you one, Decker.
